name: Nuki Smart Lock Ultra (EU)

radios.note: Nuki's Ultra datasheet lists Bluetooth Low Energy, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Thread (IEEE 802.15.4). The CSA listing names Thread and Bluetooth as Matter transports.

matter.note: CSA lists 'Nuki Smart Lock Ultra' (hardware 11.12, firmware 1.4.1, certified 2025-11-18) with Thread and Bluetooth transport.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread. Nuki's Matter help page covers the Ultra and says you need a hub that supports Matter via Thread; a Wi-Fi-only Matter hub will not work.

google_home.note: Matter over Thread, which needs a Thread border router.

alexa.note: Matter over Thread, which needs a Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Nuki's Matter help page names Samsung SmartThings hubs for Matter via Thread; a Thread border router is needed.

home_assistant.note: Nuki's Matter help page lists Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1 as a hub for Matter via Thread. Home Assistant needs a Thread border router for this.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi gives remote access without a Nuki Bridge. Matter control needs a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Nuki source describes offline or local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Ships with an integrated Universal Cylinder (58 mm) that replaces your existing cylinder; Nuki's comparison table says a cylinder change is required.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock. Nuki lists Keypad, Keypad 2 and Keypad 2 Pro as separate accessories.

power.note: Recharges in about 2 hours, on or off the door; Nuki warns when it drops below 20%.

summary: Thread-based Matter is how the Nuki Smart Lock Ultra reaches Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant, and the lock is CSA-certified. Wi-Fi is built in, so remote access needs no Nuki Bridge. It's a cylinder lock: the 58 mm Universal Cylinder replaces yours. The battery is built in and recharges in about 2 hours, and there's no keypad on the lock itself.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router; Nuki says a Wi-Fi-only Matter hub will not work.
Installation means swapping your existing cylinder for the integrated one.
